messages:
deploy-bot: [release-start] Initiating regional sweep for release rwinf/v2.3.1 (commit abc1f9d). Envs: prod-us, prod-eu, prod-apac. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollout owner: @mia (releases)

mia (releases): starting monitoring dashboards and smoke tests. cc @liz (sre) @devin

devin: ack — I'll watch autoscale and infra metrics, have runbooks open.

deploy-bot: [us] rollout started — 10% canary on 4 instances. tag: rwinf/v2.3.1-us-canary

sanjay: kicking off smoke tests against the US canary now (smoke-suite -> /run).

deploy-bot: [us] canary passed — p50 latency +5ms, errors 0.01%. advancing to 50%.

mia (releases): rolling to 50% for US.

deploy-bot: [us] rollout complete — 100% on prod-us. duration: 7m. commit abc1f9d.

deploy-bot: [eu] starting — 10% canary on 6 instances. tag: rwinf/v2.3.1-eu-canary

liz (sre): watching EU traces, enabling verbose logs for two minutes.

deploy-bot: [eu] canary failure detected — elevated 5xx from a subset of pods during Step 2. failure mode: OOM during tokenizer init. failing container: model-inference-3

devin: recommending pin & rollback for EU until we investigate. better to avoid customer impact.

mia (releases): agreed. pin prod-eu to rwinf/v2.3.0 and abort EU rollout. opening incident and linking to release notes.

deploy-bot: [eu] rollback initiated — pinning prod-eu -> rwinf/v2.3.0. reverting 12 pods. eta ~4m.

sanjay: capturing crash logs and heap dumps now. logs uploaded: s3://redwood-logs/releases/1765432100/eu-oom.log

ashley (product): noted. any customer-facing impact in EU? should we notify support to prepare comms? cc @support

deploy-bot: [apac] starting canary — 10% on 3 instances. tag: rwinf/v2.3.1-apac-canary

deploy-bot: [apac] canary passed — proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: [apac] performance regression observed at long sequence lengths: tokenization slowdown causing tail-latency spikes. recommendation: rollback APAC to rwinf/v2.3.0 for safety.

mia (releases): proceeding with APAC rollback. EU and APAC will be pinned to v2.3.0; US remains on v2.3.1. updating release notes accordingly.

liz (sre): action items — 1) collect heap profiles from failing EU pods, 2) reproduce tokenizer init in a prod-sized mem env, 3) evaluate lazy-loading tokenizer approach. creating follow-up ticket ENG-5678.

deploy-bot: [release-finish] Sweep finished for rwinf/v2.3.1. Summary: US=success, EU=rolled-back, APAC=rolled-back. Root cause: tokenizer memory init + perf regression at long seq lengths. release owner: mia (releases). incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1234

devin: thx — I'll coordinate with research to prepare a hotfix branch and load tests against the tokenizer change.

ashley (product): I'll update customers in the EU/APAC change log and pause any automated feature flags that depend on v2.3.1 behavior.

mia (releases): closing thread. follow-ups tracked in OPS-1234 and ENG-5678. :white_check_mark:
